recognize_zh: 周邊血抹片中四顆中至大型的非典型淋巴樣細胞，核質比極高、染色質細緻、隱約可見核仁，其中幾顆核有凹陷或裂溝（notch/cleft），外觀像母細胞但細胞質極少、無顆粒，需以流式細胞儀區分母細胞與高惡性度淋巴瘤白血化。
features: Four intermediate-to-large atypical mononuclear cells, about 1.5–2 times a red cell diameter
Very high N:C ratio with a thin rim of pale agranular cytoplasm
Round to indented nuclei, with nuclear notches/clefts in some cells
Finely dispersed to slightly condensed chromatin with faint small nucleoli
Background red cells largely normocytic/normochromic with occasional elongated forms; platelets present
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows normocytic, normochromic red cells with occasional elongated forms and adequate platelets. There are several intermediate-to-large atypical lymphoid cells with very high nuclear-to-cytoplasmic ratios, scant agranular cytoplasm, finely dispersed chromatin, small nucleoli and nuclear notching or clefting in some cells. No Auer rods, cytoplasmic granules or vacuoles are seen. Findings are consistent with circulating blastoid atypical lymphoid cells; in the clinical context of t(14;18)-positive lymphoma this is suggestive of leukemic spill of a high-grade/transformed B-cell lymphoma, with flow cytometry needed to exclude acute leukemia.

ddx.vs: Blasts are TdT/CD34 positive and, if myeloid, may carry granules or Auer rods, so immunophenotyping is needed because morphology alone cannot exclude blastic leukemia.

ddx.dx: Leukemic phase of follicular lymphoma (buttock cells)
ddx.vs: Low-grade FL cells are small with condensed chromatin and deep clefts, rather than intermediate-to-large cells with dispersed chromatin and nucleoli.
Blastoid MCL has similar cytology but is CD5+/cyclin D1+/SOX11+.
Reactive lymphocytes have abundant basophilic cytoplasm that hugs adjacent red cells and a heterogeneous spectrum, not uniform high N:C cells.
